research_backed_contextual_notes: Google Business Profile local rankings are framed by relevance, distance, and prominence, so the article should prioritize complete profile data, accurate location/service information, reviews, and local authority.
Google states that SEO helps search engines understand content and helps users decide whether to visit through search results; avoid implying SEO is a shortcut or guaranteed ranking lever.
Google says SEO results can take from months to a year, so the article should set expectations around staged progress rather than instant patient volume.

Dental content intersects with health-related decision-making, so the article should emphasize E-E-A-T, named clinical reviewers where appropriate, accurate sources, and no unsupported treatment claims.
